messages:
Nina (AE): Hey team, large EU retailer asked for: an exportable subprocessor list with roles, an EU-only dataflow PNG for their vendor portal, and confirmation whether logs are processed by any US vendors. They also want to know about tokenization options for PII in requests.
Omar (Security): We can confirm: EU-hosted data and logs remain in eu-central-1/eu-west-1 depending on the tenant. No US subprocessors have access to raw inference requests for EU-hosted customers. Tokenization: we provide pseudonymization and token-hash options: salted hash or deterministic tokenization depending on query needs.
Tara (Solutions): Small ASCII sketch for the portal.
```
Retail App (EU) -> TLS -> Edge (eu-central-1)
  -> Auth & routing -> Inference (eu-central-1)
  -> Ephemeral KV cache (in-region)
  -> Results -> Retail App
  -> Audit logs (eu-central-1) [replication: off]
```
Tara (Solutions): I'll export as PNG after security confirms text.
Ben (Product): Recommend Dedicated POC if they need customer KMS or signed subproc liability. Hosted is fine for quick trials. Also note: analytics/metrics are pseudonymized before any external pipeline.
Hana (Legal): We can attach the current subprocessor CSV. For POCs we provide a snapshot and a one-line attestation. If they need contractual changes, that's a legal track.
artifacts-bot: Subprocessor CSV: https://internal.redwood/docs/subprocessors/1875403210-retail-snapshot.csv (access: sales,legal)
Omar (Security): I'll prepare a one-pager covering: KMS options, tokenization choices (salted/deterministic), explicit statement about no US subproc access to raw payloads, and attach CSV. ETA 2pm tomorrow.
Nina (AE): Thanks everyone. Deliverables: Omar one-pager + CSV link, Tara PNG, Hana attestation. I9ll upload to risk portal. :white_check_mark:
